import json,sympy as s
# One CLOSED mode with face norm²4: HE=256 p², E_c=4p. Matrix potential is periodic.
a=s.Integer(256);M=s.Integer(1024);E0=a-M
H=s.Matrix([[a,-M,0],[-M,a,0],[0,0,E0]]);L=H-E0*s.eye(3)
g=s.Matrix([1,1,0])/s.sqrt(2);h=s.Matrix([0,0,1]);v=s.Matrix([1,-1,0])/s.sqrt(2)
P=g*g.H+h*h.H;Q=s.eye(3)-P;Ec=s.diag(-4,4,0);B=s.zeros(3);B[2,0]=1;A=B+B.H
assert L*g==s.zeros(3,1) and L*h==s.zeros(3,1) and L*v==2*M*v
assert P*Ec*P==s.zeros(3)
assert Ec*B-B*Ec==4*B
assert Q*A*g==s.zeros(3,1) and (g.H*A*g)[0]==0
assert s.simplify((g.H*A*A*g)[0])==s.Rational(1,2)
inv=s.simplify((g.H*Ec*(v*v.H/(2*M))*Ec*g)[0]);assert inv==s.Rational(1,128)<=s.Rational(1,64)
assert Q*A*h!=s.zeros(3,1)
# ALL real Bloch k, not a selected beta: lower branch a(k²+1)-sqrt(M²+4a²k²)>=a-M.
k=s.symbols('k',real=True);difference=s.expand((M+a*k*k)**2-(M*M+4*a*a*k*k))
assert s.Poly(difference,k).all_coeffs()==[a*a,0,2*a*(M-2*a),0,0]
assert M>=2*a
